# hooksmith

> Generate, lint and fire-test lifecycle hooks for coding agents: the hooks part of an agent's harness, as a CLI, an MCP server, three skills and a Claude Code plugin.

## Start here

- [AGENTS.md](AGENTS.md): what hooksmith does, every tool and how to call it, what not to do
- [README.md](README.md): overview, quick start, the recipe catalog and linter violations
- [identity/SOUL.md](identity/SOUL.md): who hooksmith is, what it owns, its boundaries

## Skills

- [skills/hook-generate/SKILL.md](skills/hook-generate/SKILL.md): generate a hooks block for a project from the recipe catalog
- [skills/hook-lint/SKILL.md](skills/hook-lint/SKILL.md): lint a hooks block against today's 33 events and 5 handler types
- [skills/hook-fire-test/SKILL.md](skills/hook-fire-test/SKILL.md): fire a hook with a synthetic event and read its decision, locally or in E2B

## MCP tools

- [src/mcp-server.ts](src/mcp-server.ts): `hooksmith-mcp` with `hook_generate`, `hook_lint` and `hook_test`

## Code

- [src/generator.ts](src/generator.ts): `generateHooksBlock()`, emit a hooks block
- [src/linter.ts](src/linter.ts): `lintHooksBlock()`, validate a hooks block; `VALID_EVENTS`
- [src/fire-test.ts](src/fire-test.ts): `fireTest()`, run one hook the way Claude Code would
- [catalog/recipes.json](catalog/recipes.json): the machine-readable recipe registry

## Optional

- [identity/MEMORY.md](identity/MEMORY.md): bootstrap facts, hook events, the recipe table
- [identity/LEARNINGS.md](identity/LEARNINGS.md): corrections that became rules
- [dsip.json](dsip.json): the self-improvement contract
